verse.unicode: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਗਨਹੁ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥

transliteration.english: jis kau bisarai praanapat dhaataa soiee ganahu abhaagaa ||

en.bdb: One who forgets the Lord of life, the Great Giver - know that he is most unfortunate.

verse.unicode: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਗਿਓ ਅਮਿਅ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਪਾਗਾ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: charan kamal jaa kaa man raagio amia sarovar paagaa ||1||

en.bdb: One whose mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet, obtains the pool of ambrosial nectar. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥

transliteration.english: teraa jan raam naam ra(n)g jaagaa ||

en.bdb: Your humble servant awakes in the Love of the Lord's Name.

verse.unicode: ਆਲਸੁ ਛੀਜਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: aalas chheej giaa sabh tan te preetam siau man laagaa || rahaau ||

en.bdb: All laziness has departed from his body, and his mind is attached to the Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥

transliteration.english: jeh jeh pekhau teh naarain sagal ghaTaa meh taagaa ||

en.bdb: Wherever I look, the Lord is there; He is the string, upon which all hearts are strung.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੭॥

transliteration.english: naam udhak peevat jan naanak tiaage sabh anuraagaa ||2||16||47||

en.bdb: Drinking in the water of the Naam, servant Nanak has renounced all other loves. ||2||16||47||
